sections.heading: How your free website preview works

steps.title: Tell us about your business
steps.body: Share your business name, website and a few basic details. We’ll review your current online presence and identify the best way to create a useful preview.

steps.title: We build your private preview
steps.body: We use your real business information, services, branding and publicly available content to create a private website preview tailored to your business.
steps.note: No payment is required to review it.

steps.title: Review it privately for 7 days
steps.body: Explore your preview on a private link for seven days. It isn’t public, and your existing website stays unchanged while you review the new version.

steps.title: Choose a plan or simply walk away
steps.body: If you like the preview, choose a monthly plan and we’ll complete, launch and manage the website for you. If it isn’t right for you, the preview expires — with no obligation.
